name: Endeavour (STS-134)
about: Endeavour (STS-134) (2011-020A), a crewed vehicle (STS), launched 2011 May 16. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2011 May 17), held fixed
docked to A06140; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
